subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
Common Data for Q.3 and 4: 
Consider a noncoherently detected orthogonal binary 
FSK system having the higher frequency signaling 
tone 1 MHz and the symbol duration 1 ms. 
3.
The frequency signaling tones of the system are
(a)
1 MHz, 10 MHz
(b)
1 MHz, 999 kHz
(c)
1 MHz, 99 kHz
(d)
1 MHz, 1.1 MHz
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-06 (PRACTICE SHEET 01).
